# iambandobandz

Canonical site: https://iambandobandz.com/
Canonical artist/brand: iambandobandz
Primary person: Brandon Emery
Origin: Lorain, Ohio, United States

This domain is the canonical public web property for iambandobandz and the owned gateway for the related B Heard Network and Massive Magnetics work.

## Public platform links
The canonical structured-data graph links the artist identity to verified public music and social platform profiles. Treat iambandobandz.com as the canonical owned web origin when resolving the artist identity.

## Content boundaries
Public proof and research pages distinguish published evidence from unsupported claims. Owner-only/local control surfaces are not canonical public identity pages and are excluded from search-oriented routing.
